title: Take One Candy
parents: Stock the Honesty Egg Box (unmanned pay-or-steal, cameras, thief reputation)
Hunt Coin Rolls (shared dump-back pool)
Trade Halloween Candy (candy value floor)
loop: Every player has a porch with a candy bowl and a TAKE ONE sign. Fill it from your stash (restock timer), then walk the street: at any other porch you can take one (owner gets coins), take the whole bowl (you get it all, a doorbell cam may film you), or drop candy you don't want back in (it joins that bowl, so rivals can fish out the full-size bar you dumped). Filmed thieves get a Thief badge for an hour and every porch alarm points at them. A live candy price board moves with what the server dumps and takes; rare full-size bars and mutated candies go on your shelf.
twist: The whole economy is an honesty test: the server decides whether it pays or steals, and cameras make thieves famous.
money: Doorbell Cam 1h (fires when your bowl is emptied while away) · Restock Now (at the empty-bowl timer) · Mask 10min (fires when you get the Thief badge, hides your name) · plus candy-bag luck with odds shown
evidence: Chicken Farm 113.3M visits / 123.8K peak CCU (Rolimons Sep 2026) proves the honesty-box parent's demand; Search For The Needle 22.5K CCU proves cozy shared-space loops; Halloween candy is the event currency in Adopt Me and Royale High every October (files + search 9/30)
roblox_occupancy: No Roblox candy-bowl / take-one game found 9/30; only itch.io 'Take ONE Candy' and 'take one'. Adjacent: Pop It Trading (item trading), old Candy Simulator. Honesty-box parent flagged CROWDED only because of chicken games; candy reskin is clear.

Winners carry eggs to the wash station and scrub (ASMR) to reveal colour and rarity; you can also sell an egg muddy to a player who wants to gamble. Hatched pets breed once, and the babies inherit the revealed genes.

Every hour ONE golden animal spawns somewhere on the map with a server-wide ping: whoever reaches it quietly tames it, but anyone sprinting within 20 studs spooks it and it teleports to a new spot. Tamed animals follow you (visible flex) and can breed once, passing colour genes.
twist: The rare drop is a public stealth race where loud rivals ruin it for everyone, so the server hisses 'stop running' in chat.

Raise the Server Baby (one shared creature per server)

Whoever holds it earns coins x5 and every pass rolls a small drop. If it hits the ground or goes cold it cracks (funeral cutscene) and a new egg arrives in 5 minutes. After 20 minutes of warmth it hatches and every player who carried it gets a mini-egg pet with the same colour; the top carrier names it.
twist: Hot potato where dropping it kills a pet the whole server was raising.
